page.layout: One printed page: woodcut headpiece and title block at top, then one column of running text with a large woodcut initial; no margin notes; signature and catchword line at foot.

main_text.head: DISPUTATIO THEOLOGICA De JUSTIFICATIONE HOMINIS PECCATORIS CORAM DEO.
THESIS I.
main_text.p: PRÆCIPUUS ut facilè est justificationis articulus eorum, qui inter Nos & Pontificios agitantur, ita rectè intellectus quàm maximè illustrat & amplificat honorem Christi, veram Dei ecclesiam à Judæis, Paganis, ecclesia Antichristi aliorumque hæreticorum separat, in hocq; cardo salutis nostræ & solidæ consolationis unicè vertitur: dignus igitur cognitione nostrâ: cognoscemus autem illius præstantiam, si naturam ejus in causis & annexis ex S. Scripturæ monumentis (imprimis ex Epistola ad Romanos & Galatas ubi propria hujus loci sedes est) Orthodoxorum Theologorum documentis, Conciliorum & Confessionum publicarum constanti harmonia consideremus: quô pensô breviter ex demandato superiorum, bono cum Deo, defungemur.
main_text.head: II.
main_text.p: Ordiamur ab ipsa voce: Vox justificationis in hoc negotio

page.notes: The large initial "P" is a woodcut letter, read as P with the rest of the word "RÆCIPUUS" (printed "PRÆCIPUUS"); "PRÆCIPUUS" set with a woodcut initial. Title lines set in capitals and larger type. The text is only partly legible at the catchword; "gotio" is the catchword continuing onto the next page. Some letters in the body are worn and read with some doubt.
